## Scope

Describe the problem and the smallest complete change that solves it.

## Verification

List exact commands, outcomes, and any real-device evidence. Explicitly identify
checks that were blocked or not run.

## Risk and compatibility

- Security or privacy boundary changed: yes / no
- Protocol or persisted-data compatibility changed: yes / no
- Rollback approach:

## Provenance

- New or adapted third-party code/assets: yes / no
- `THIRD_PARTY.md`, licenses, notices, and SBOM inputs updated when required: yes / not applicable

## Checklist

- [ ] The diff is limited to the stated scope and handles errors explicitly.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects actual behavior and does not claim unverified support.
- [ ] No credentials, private device/network details, or personal screen content are included.
